label: 연회에 직접 합류한다
success_text_en: As you drain your cup, your conviction fills back up.
fail_text_en: You drink too much and botch the next day's sermon.

label: 공허함을 끝까지 견딘다
label_en: Endure the emptiness to the end
success_text: 조용한 인내가 이상하게 마음을 단단히 합니다. 측근들은 키득거립니다.
success_text_en: Quiet endurance strangely steadies you. Your aides snicker.

label: 그것이 축복이라 답한다
label_en: Answer that it is a blessing
success_text: 신도의 눈이 반짝이며 고개를 깊이 숙입니다.
success_text_en: The follower's eyes shine as they bow deeply.

label: 만족을 배워보라 권한다
success_text_en: The follower falls into thought, then thanks you.
fail_text_en: Whispers spread: "Is the Master a temperance freak?"

label: 더 큰 몫을 원하는 자를 편든다
label_en: Side with the one who wants more
success_text: 탐욕스러운 쪽이 충성을 맹세합니다. 다른 쪽은 이를 갑니다.
success_text_en: The greedy one swears loyalty. The other grinds their teeth.

label: 둘 다 꾸짖고 공평히 나눈다
label_en: Scold both and split it fairly
success_text: 공정한 판결에 둘 다 마지못해 수긍합니다.
success_text_en: Both grudgingly accept your fair ruling.
fail_text: "공평이라니, 촌스럽게" 하며 둘 다 등을 돌립니다.
fail_text_en: "Fairness? How quaint," they both scoff, turning away.

label: 이름을 금박으로 새긴다
success_text: 상인이 흡족해하며 다음 달에도 오겠다 합니다.
success_text_en: Pleased, the merchant promises to return next month.

label: 가격을 두 배로 부른다
success_text: 상인이 감탄하며 지갑을 엽니다. 이 세계에선 배짱이 곧 신용입니다.
success_text_en: Impressed, he opens his wallet. Here, nerve is credit.
fail_text_en: The merchant takes his money to a rival cult.

label: 이름 없이 받으라 한다
success_text_en: Baffled, he leaves only a small sum.

label: 야유에 가세해 관중을 끈다
label_en: Join the jeers and win the crowd
success_text_en: The crowd cheers your words and follows you.

label: 설교자를 감싸준다
success_text_en: A few quiet souls follow you.
fail_text_en: The crowd turns its jeers on you.

label: 야망을 최상위로 공인한다
success_text_en: Doctrine grows sharper. The Appetite faction sulks.

label: 모든 욕망은 평등하다 선언한다
success_text_en: Everyone leaves the debate satisfied.
fail_text_en: A rebuttal exposes your logic and leaves you speechless.

label: 가장 먼저 집는 자를 축복한다
success_text_en: Laughter and a scramble erupt at the table.

label: 잘게 나눠 모두 맛보게 한다
label_en: Cut it so everyone gets a taste
success_text: 작은 한 입이 이상한 유대감을 만듭니다.
success_text_en: A tiny bite creates a strange bond.
fail_text_en: Complaints of "how stingy" burst out.

label: 1위를 목표로 사치 행사를 연다
label_en: Throw a lavish event to aim for #1
success_text_en: A photo of your golden fountain makes the front page.
fail_text_en: You only earn mockery for a shabby event.

label: 순위 따위 무시한다
success_text_en: You stay calm. Reporters call you 'the listless leader.'

label: 불태워 과거를 끊는다
label_en: Burn it and cut off the past
success_text_en: As the ashes scatter, your heart lightens.

label: 몰래 서랍에 간직한다
label_en: Secretly keep it in a drawer
success_text: 가끔 꺼내 읽으면 이상하게 위안이 됩니다.
success_text_en: Reading it now and then is oddly comforting.

label: 용기 있는 욕망이라 치하한다
success_text_en: The follower leaves triumphant.

label: 상대의 마음도 존중하라 이른다
label_en: Tell him to respect her feelings too
success_text_en: Unexpectedly, he takes it to heart.
fail_text: 신도가 실망한 얼굴로 다른 설교자를 찾아갑니다.
fail_text_en: Disappointed, he seeks out another preacher.

label: 야망을 칭찬하고 자리를 내준다
label_en: Praise his ambition and let him sit
success_text_en: Followers are moved: 'The Master loves ambition.'

label: 모두 앞에서 끌어내린다
label_en: Drag him off in front of everyone
success_text_en: The hierarchy is made crystal clear.
fail_text_en: The recruit makes a scene and leaves.

label: '더 많이 넣으면 더 축복'으로 바꾼다
label_en: Change it to 'Give more, get more blessing'
success_text_en: The box quickly grows heavy.

label: 그대로 둔다
success_text_en: Visitors chuckle at the sign.

label: 화끈하게 연다
success_text: 밤새 춤추던 이들이 아침에 입교 서류를 씁니다.
success_text_en: Those who danced all night sign up by morning.
fail_text_en: A police raid ends the party.

label: 조용한 다과회로 바꾼다
label_en: Turn it into a quiet tea party
success_text_en: A few come, yawn, and leave.

label: 인내를 죄로 규정한다
success_text_en: 'Waiting is defeat' is added to the scriptures.

label: 결정을 미룬다
success_text: 미룬 덕에 더 정교한 안이 나옵니다.
success_text_en: The delay yields a more refined proposal.
fail_text_en: Accusations pour in: "The leader is a patience zealot!"

label: 최고 과시자에게 상을 준다
success_text_en: A night of envy and cheers.

label: 가진 것 없는 자도 무대에 올린다
label_en: Let the have-nots take the stage too
success_text_en: Unexpected wit has everyone laughing.
fail_text: 가난한 신도가 망신만 당하고 울며 나갑니다.
fail_text_en: The poor follower is humiliated and leaves in tears.

label: 도발적으로 말한다
success_text: 시청률이 치솟고 당신 이름이 검색어 1위가 됩니다.
success_text_en: Ratings soar and your name tops the search charts.
fail_text_en: Your words are edited into a laughingstock.

label: 정중하게 사양한다
success_text_en: A panelist's joke about the 'coward leader' goes on air.

label: 거지 앞에서 빵을 먹는다
label_en: Eat bread in front of the beggar
success_text_en: Followers applaud: 'A true leader!'

label: 몰래 빵을 건넨다
success_text: 거지의 감사 인사가 오래 마음에 남습니다.
success_text_en: The beggar's thanks lingers in your heart.
fail_text_en: A follower sees, and rumors spread.

label: 식욕의 성자라 칭찬한다
label_en: Praise him as a saint of Appetite
success_text: 모두 웃으며 졸던 신도가 영웅이 됩니다.
success_text_en: Everyone laughs and the dozer becomes a hero.

label: 의식의 엄숙함을 일깨운다
label_en: Remind all of the ritual's solemnity
success_text_en: The ritual regains its focus.
fail_text_en: Grumbles spread that the leader's gotten uptight.

label: 두 배 보수를 제시한다
success_text_en: The aide stays for the smell of money.

label: 충성심에 호소한다
success_text_en: Moved, the aide's eyes redden.
fail_text_en: "Loyalty? Does that put food on the table?" The aide leaves.

label: 그 대담함을 승진으로 보상한다
success_text: 재무 담당이 앞으로 더 크게 벌어오겠다 맹세합니다.
success_text_en: The treasurer vows to bring in even more.

label: 철저히 감사한다
success_text_en: Hidden funds turn up one after another.
fail_text_en: Followers mutter that the audit is petty.

label: 화려한 퍼포먼스로 강연한다
success_text_en: Students line up for membership consultations.
fail_text_en: Underprepared, you get booed.

label: 진지한 학술 강의를 한다
success_text_en: A few studious types take interest.

label: '절제를 비웃어라'로 번역시킨다
success_text_en: Doctrine is reinforced, though the translator's hands tremble.

label: 원문 그대로 공개한다
success_text: 정직한 공개가 도리어 학자들의 존경을 삽니다.
success_text_en: Honest disclosure earns scholars' respect.
fail_text_en: Doctrine wavers and followers fall into confusion.

label: 당신도 원에 들어가 고백한다
label_en: Join the circle and confess too
success_text_en: The circle heats up at the leader's candor.
fail_text_en: Your confession is too much and your aides squirm.

label: 밖에서 지켜보며 축복한다
success_text_en: A mystic distance is preserved.

label: 성대한 시식회를 연다
success_text_en: Food photos flood social media.
fail_text_en: A food poisoning scare breaks out.

label: 소박한 금식 의식을 보여준다
success_text_en: The chef leaves calling it a failed concept.

label: 수익을 나누자 제안한다
success_text_en: The business becomes official and sales rise.

label: 배신으로 규정하고 내쫓는다
label_en: Call it betrayal and expel him
success_text_en: Tension runs through the cult.

label: 모두 받는다
success_text_en: The children leave, seething.

label: 절반만 받는다
success_text_en: Even the children grudgingly agree.
fail_text_en: Gossip calls you a half-hearted leader.

label: 직접 출전한다
success_text_en: The crowd goes wild at your victory belch.
fail_text_en: You give up midway and become a joke.

label: 가장 대식가 신도를 내보낸다
success_text_en: The follower wins and becomes a cult hero.
fail_text_en: A crushing loss; some followers defect.

label: 대결을 거절한다
success_text_en: Mockery spreads: 'Frightened light eaters.'

label: 공개적으로 사치를 과시한다
success_text_en: A new gold watch silences the doubts.

label: 진짜 욕망은 내면에 있다고 설교한다
label_en: Preach that true desire lies within
success_text_en: The profound sermon wins them over.
fail_text_en: Followers shake their heads at the sophistry.

label: 두둑하게 찔러준다
success_text: 허가가 하루 만에 나옵니다. 이 세계에선 미덕입니다.
success_text_en: The permit arrives in a day. Here, that's a virtue.

label: 정식 절차를 고집한다
success_text_en: You gain an odd fame as an honest leader.
fail_text_en: You're branded an inflexible fool.

label: 응답을 기다린다
success_text_en: At dawn, certainty spreads through your chest.
fail_text_en: Only silence returns.

label: 질문을 접고 축배를 든다
label_en: Drop the question and raise a toast
success_text_en: The drink blurs your worries.

label: 모두 앞에서 조롱하며 보낸다
label_en: Mock him publicly as he leaves
success_text_en: Remaining followers bond tighter.

label: 축복하며 보내준다
label_en: Send him off with a blessing
success_text_en: Your generosity leaves a surprisingly good impression.
fail_text_en: Rumors say the leader is wavering too.

label: 가장 야심찬 자를 지명한다
success_text_en: The chosen one exults; the rest sharpen knives.

label: 서로 경쟁하게 둔다
success_text: 경쟁 속에 모두 당신에게 더 충성합니다.
success_text_en: In competition, all grow more loyal to you.
fail_text_en: The power struggle becomes a public scandal.

label: 두 번 판다
success_text: 아무도 눈치채지 못한 채 수익이 두 배입니다.
success_text_en: No one notices, and profits double.
fail_text_en: The two winners meet at the same restaurant.

label: 정직하게 한 번만 판다
success_text_en: The winner enjoys a satisfying dinner.

label: 성대한 환영 연회를 연다
success_text_en: Most pilgrims decide to stay.

label: 시험을 거쳐 받아들인다
success_text_en: Those who remain become an elite.
fail_text_en: Most leave, calling you too picky.

label: 금기어로 지정한다
success_text_en: The doctrine becomes sharper.

label: '전략적 자애'로 재정의한다
success_text: 주는 것도 투자라는 해석이 호응을 얻습니다.
success_text_en: The idea that giving is investing catches on.
fail_text_en: Theologians sneer at the wordplay.

label: 욕망이 큰 쪽이 이긴다고 판결한다
label_en: Rule that the stronger desire wins
success_text_en: The winner cheers; the loser resents.

label: 셋이 함께 대화하게 한다
label_en: Have all three talk it out
success_text_en: Surprisingly, the three become friends.
fail_text_en: The talk ends in a brawl.

label: '각성 전후' 마케팅으로 활용한다
label_en: Use it as 'before and after awakening' marketing
success_text_en: Your dramatic transformation story goes viral.
fail_text_en: Suspicion of fakery only grows.

label: 삭제 요청을 넣는다
success_text: 삭제할수록 더 퍼지지만, 마음은 조금 정리됩니다.
success_text_en: The more you delete, the more it spreads, but your mind settles a little.

label: 모든 유혹을 즐긴다
success_text_en: The aide marvels: 'As expected of the Master.'

label: 유혹을 거절하고 명상한다
success_text_en: In stillness you feel closer to God.
fail_text_en: The aide blabs that the leader has turned.

label: 황금 동상을 요구한다
success_text_en: The gleaming statue becomes their pride.
fail_text: 모금이 부족해 반쯤 금칠한 동상이 됩니다.
fail_text_en: Funds run short; the statue is half-gilded.

label: 돈을 공동 만찬에 쓰라 한다
label_en: Tell them to spend it on a communal feast
success_text_en: Well-fed followers sing your praises.

label: 그 열정을 무대에서 보여주게 한다
label_en: Let him show his passion on stage
success_text: 분위기가 뜨거워지고 당신은 관대한 지도자가 됩니다.
success_text_en: The mood ignites and you look generous.
fail_text_en: Followers begin following him instead.

label: 즉시 침묵시킨다
success_text_en: The ritual returns to your hands.

label: 사서 비싸게 되판다
label_en: Buy it and resell at a markup
success_text_en: Followers rush to make offerings to the 'grail.'
fail_text_en: It's exposed as fake and you lose the money.

label: 가짜임을 폭로한다
success_text: 상인은 도망치고 몇몇은 당신을 '너무 정직하다'며 웃습니다.
success_text_en: The dealer flees; some laugh that you're 'too honest.'

label: 촛불 연회로 바꾼다
label_en: Turn it into a candlelit banquet
success_text_en: The banquet in the dark becomes legend.

label: 조용히 쉬어갈 곳만 내준다
label_en: Simply offer them a quiet place to rest
success_text_en: A grateful few stay.
fail_text_en: They leave calling your cult boring.

label: 논쟁으로 박살낸다
success_text_en: Your rebuttal makes it into textbooks.
fail_text_en: You lose the debate and are humiliated.

label: 그 주장을 교리에 흡수한다
success_text_en: Doctrine grows flexible. Purists are uneasy.

label: 공짜 술을 제공한다
success_text_en: Attendance recovers immediately.

label: 모임 진행을 신도들에게 맡긴다
success_text_en: A new vitality flows.
fail_text_en: The meetings go off the rails.

label: 루머를 부채질한다
success_text_en: Visitors surge.
fail_text_en: The celebrity denies it publicly, embarrassing you.

label: 사실이 아니라고 정정한다
success_text_en: Jokes spread about a cult 'sick with honesty.'

label: 가져간 자에게 상을 걸고 자수를 권한다
label_en: Offer a reward for the thief to confess
success_text_en: The thief confesses and demands a place in the circle.
fail_text_en: No one steps up and the vault is emptied.

label: 전원 몸수색을 명한다
success_text_en: The key is found, but the mood is icy.

label: 음식을 팔아 헌금으로 삼는다
success_text_en: A modest profit comes in.

label: 아이들을 연회에 초대한다
label_en: Invite the children to the banquet
success_text: 아이들의 웃음에 마음이 따뜻해지지만, 구경꾼들은 고개를 갸웃합니다.
success_text_en: The children's laughter warms your heart, though onlookers tilt their heads.
fail_text_en: You're blasted as 'anachronistically charitable.'

label: 열렬히 지지한다
success_text_en: He wins, and your influence grows with him.
fail_text: 그가 낙선해 당신도 함께 웃음거리가 됩니다.
fail_text_en: He loses, and you become a joke along with him.

label: 중립을 지킨다
success_text_en: Both sides call you 'the lukewarm leader.'

label: 스스로 성대한 잔치를 연다
success_text: 당신을 위한 당신의 잔치, 이것이야말로 교리입니다.
success_text_en: A party by you, for you—this is doctrine itself.

label: 홀로 조용히 촛불을 켠다
success_text: 고독 속에서 오래 잊었던 평화를 느낍니다.
success_text_en: In solitude you feel a long-forgotten peace.
fail_text_en: Loneliness weighs on you all night.

label: 웃으며 다음엔 1등 하겠다 선언한다
label_en: Laugh and vow to be first next time
success_text_en: Followers cheer their good-humored leader.

label: 투표를 무효로 선언한다
success_text_en: The vote never happened.
fail_text_en: Rumor spreads that the leader is sulking over losing.
